name: Prayer Ring
desc: While at a glance this may just look like a beautiful ring, it is said to grant countless blessings upon whoever makes a wish on it.

eff.name: Feather Boots
eff.desc1: Extends the duration of invulnerability when evading by [Lv. x 1]%.

eff.name: Veil of Light
eff.desc1: Restores [Lv. x 2]% HP after performing a Precision Counter. Boosts the ATK, DEF, and SPD of the swapped in character by [Lv. x 2]%.

eff.name: Saintly Prayers
eff.desc1: Grants a [Lv. x 1]% chance to survive an attack with 1 HP that otherwise would have been a KO.
